news.title: Hanuman Ansh Shatters Records With Massive Box Office Return
news.summary: The low-budget film Hanuman Ansh has crossed the 400 crore gross mark on its 52nd day of theatrical release. Made on a modest budget, the movie has defied expectations to sustain strong collections globally over seven weeks.

news.title: The Paradise Faces Its Ultimate Box Office Trial on Monday
news.summary: Despite receiving largely negative reviews and social media trolling, Nani's latest starrer has posted impressive opening weekend collections driven by strong numbers in Telangana. The film's true box office stamina will now be tested as regular working weekdays begin.

news.title: Venkatesh and Trivikram's Aadarsha Kutumbam Unveils First Single
news.summary: The makers of Aadarsha Kutumbam House No.47 have released their opening single titled Narayanamma, composed by Thaman S. The film reunites actor Venkatesh and director Trivikram Srinivas after two decades and is slated for a worldwide theatrical release on October 9, 2026.

news.title: Surprising OTT Acquisition Rights Reported for Love & War
news.summary: Sanjay Leela Bhansali's upcoming period drama Love & War, starring Ranbir Kapoor, Alia Bhatt, and Vicky Kaushal, has reportedly finalized its digital streaming agreement with ZEE5. The modest transaction amount has drawn widespread attention across industry circles given the massive scale of the project.

news.title: Prabhas unveils plot details for romantic entertainer Romeo Juliet
news.summary: Pan-India star Prabhas shared a cryptic social media post that led into the official story reveal for the upcoming romantic film Romeo Juliet. Directed by Bhargav Macharla and starring Havish alongside Visakha Dhiman, the project features music by Gopi Sunder and cinematography by Abhiraj Nair. Produced by Sundeep N and Venkateswara Rao Challagulla under Navarasa Entertainments, the movie is scheduled to release on October 23, 2026.

news.title: Kaasu glimpse introduces stylish storytelling and an unusual question about love and money
news.summary: The team behind Kaasu released a stylish promotional glimpse that introduces its central characters and a narrative blending romance with obsession and human flaws. Headlined by Shree Nandu and Indu Kumar, the film is produced under AKR Dream Pictures LLP and directed by P.S. Harshavardhan. The multi-lingual project aims for a grand theatrical release across Telugu, Tamil, Malayalam, Kannada, and Hindi languages.

news.title: Shared accountability: Why film outcomes belong to the entire creative unit
news.summary: While commercial success and failure are regular occurrences in the entertainment industry, the ultimate fate of a movie is shaped by the combined efforts of its entire team. From writers and directors to actors, technicians, and financial backers across all crafts, every individual contributes to the final product. Consequently, both the triumphs and shortcomings of a project reflect the collective work of the entire unit rather than any single person.

news.title: Venkatesh's Aadarsha Kutumbam Kicks Off Promos With Vibrant Narayanamma Track
news.summary: The musical promotions for Victory Venkatesh's family entertainer Aadarsha Kutumbam have officially commenced with the release of the first single, Narayanamma. Composed by Thaman S, the festive dance track features energetic vocals by Ram Miriyala and Prabha alongside lyrics by Ramajogayya Sastry. The song highlights Dimple Hayati alongside Venkatesh, Srinidhi Shetty, and Nivetha Pethuraj ahead of the film's worldwide theatrical debut on October 9, 2026.

news.title: Prabhas Launches Gen-Z Focused Story Reveal Video For Romeo Juliet
news.summary: Pan-India star Prabhas has unveiled the story reveal video for the upcoming youthful film Romeo Juliet, directed by Bhargav Mucharla. The unconventional preview features lead actor Harshit interacting with an underworld figure while discussing modern relationship trends like situationships and one-night stands. Produced by Sundeep N and Venkateswara Rao Challagulla, the movie is slated for release on October 23, coinciding with Prabhas' birthday.

news.title: Harshith and Vishaka Dhiman Starrer Romeo Juliet Explores Modern Romance
news.summary: Directed by Bhargav Macharla, the upcoming movie Romeo Juliet examines contemporary dating dynamics and Gen-Z relationship terminology. The newly released story reveal glimpse showcases the lead character plotting an unusual course of action while touching upon modern romance vocabulary. Backed by producers Sundeep N and Venkateswara Rao Challagulla, the project features music by Gopi Sundar and hits theaters on October 23.

news.title: Adarsha Kutumbam Launches Festive First Single Narayanamma
news.summary: The promotional campaign for Venkatesh's upcoming film Adarsha Kutumbam has officially begun with the debut of its first single, Narayanamma. The dance number features performances by Dimple Hayathi, Sreenidhi Shetty, and Nivetha Pethuraj alongside the lead actor. Produced by Haarika & Hassine Creations, the family entertainer is scheduled to arrive in cinemas on October 9.

news.title: Venkatesh and Trivikram's Aadarsha Kutumbam Unveils First Single
news.summary: The makers of the upcoming film Aadarsha Kutumbam have released its opening track, Narayanamma, composed by Thaman with vocals by Prabha Bangarigalla and Ram Miriyala. Starring Venkatesh and directed by Trivikram Srinivas, the movie is slated to hit screens on October 9, 2026.

news.title: Blockbuster Malayalam Rom-Com Bethlehem Kudumba Unit Locks OTT Premiere
news.summary: The Malayalam industry hit Bethlehem Kudumba Unit, directed by Girish AD and starring Nivin Pauly and Mamitha Baiju, has scheduled its digital debut. The multi-lingual film, including a Telugu release, will stream on JioHotstar starting October 2, 2026.

news.title: Tamil Actor Suriya Advises Supporters to Avoid Digital Fights
news.summary: Tamil film star Suriya recently addressed his fan club members, advising them to steer clear of pointless online drama and negative chatter. He encouraged his supporters to channel their energy into their personal pursuits rather than answering critics.

news.title: Rajinikanth's Jailer 2 Seeks Momentum Ahead of October Release
news.summary: Superstar Rajinikanth's upcoming Tamil action sequel Jailer 2 carries massive pre-release business expectations of around ₹600 crore. However, its current promotional campaign and latest singles have received a mixed response compared to the first film. The Nelson Dilipkumar directorial is scheduled to hit theaters on October 15.

news.title: Speculation Surrounds Mahesh Babu's Next Film After Varanasi
news.summary: Mahesh Babu's upcoming project with director SS Rajamouli, titled Varanasi, is gearing up for a worldwide theatrical release on April 7, 2027. Meanwhile, industry rumors have linked several notable directors to his subsequent film, including a recent buzz involving Lokesh Kanagaraj. However, no official confirmation has been made regarding their collaboration.

news.title: Nani and Srikanth Odela Address Trolled Dialogue in The Paradise
news.summary: Actor Nani and director Srikanth Odela explained a widely criticized dialogue from their latest film, The Paradise, in a post-release interview. They revealed that the intended emotional setup for the line was edited out to control the runtime, leading to viewer misunderstandings. Despite the criticism, the Sudhakar Cherukuri-produced movie is steadily moving toward the Rs. 150 crore gross mark.

news.title: Taapsee Pannu Flaunts Retro Glam in Latest Photoshoot
news.summary: Actress Taapsee Pannu recently shared a bold new retro-themed photoshoot featuring vintage-toned aesthetics and striking fashion choices. On the professional front, she is currently filming Woh Ladki Hai Kahaan? where she plays ACP Komal Sharma. Her previous 2026 releases, Advocate Raavi and Gandhari, failed to perform well at the box office.

news.title: Junior NTR Set to Head Back to Sets for Dragon
news.summary: Following a recovery break for a shoulder injury, leading actor NTR is preparing to get back before the cameras. Director Prashanth Neel has kept production moving by shooting sequences that do not require the star in the meantime. A major two-week action schedule is planned to kick off in Mumbai on October 10th.

news.title: Anil Ravipudi Nearing Completion on January 12 Vidudala
news.summary: Filmmaker Anil Ravipudi is racing through the final stages of his upcoming project titled January 12 Vidudala. Following a brief pause while cast member Venkatesh handles other shooting commitments, the team will resume work in Ooty and abroad for remaining scenes and songs. Post-production is well underway with composer GV Prakash Kumar managing the background score.

news.title: Chakkora Theatrical Preview Unveiled in Hyderabad
news.summary: The promotional trailer for Chakkora – Lunar Love Bird has debuted to the public following an official launch event by Aakash Jagannadh. The story follows a carefree young man whose world is upended after falling in love and dealing with the sudden disappearance of the female lead. Directed by newcomer Manga Srinivas, the musical drama is slated for a worldwide theatrical release on October 9.

news.title: Fresh Character Posters Unveiled for Nitesh Tiwari's Ramayana
news.summary: New promotional stills from Nitesh Tiwari's upcoming mythological epic Ramayana have been revealed to the public. The imagery highlights Ranbir Kapoor, Sai Pallavi, and Ravi Dubey as Ram, Sita, and Lakshman against an expansive landscape, alongside a first look at Yash portraying Ravana. Backed by major production houses, the first part of the ambitious cinematic project is scheduled to arrive in cinemas for Diwali 2026.

news.title: NTR to Resume Shooting for Dragon Next Month
news.summary: Actor NTR is set to return to film sets following a shoulder injury and subsequent surgery that kept him out of action for nearly two months. He will join a 15-day shooting schedule in Mumbai starting October 10 to film high-octane action sequences alongside Anil Kapoor. Directed by Prashanth Neel and produced by Mythri Movie Makers, the pan-India project is currently slated for release in June 2027.

news.title: Fresh Character Posters Unveiled for Ramayana
news.summary: The makers of the epic adaptation Ramayana have released two new character posters highlighting Yash as Ravana and the trio of Ram, Lakshmana, and Sita. Directed by Nitesh Tiwari, the multi-part project features music by AR Rahman and Hans Zimmer. The film is planned for release across two parts during the Diwali seasons of 2026 and 2027.
